sections.text: TDEE calculators use population averages. They do not know your specific muscle mass, NEAT level, or metabolic efficiency. Research shows that actual TDEE can vary by 200-300 calories from the estimate, and in some cases up to 500-600 calories. The solution is a simple 2-3 week tracking protocol.

items: Calculate estimated TDEE using the calculator.
Eat exactly that many calories every day for 2 weeks. Track everything — all food, drinks, oils, condiments.
Weigh yourself daily under consistent conditions (morning, after bathroom, before food).
After 2 weeks, average your weight changes.
If weight stayed exactly stable: calculated TDEE is correct. If you lost or gained weight: adjust by 100-200 calories per pound of change.
